exposure.needed: whether cert-manager is installed and upgraded through an OperatorHub/OLM package (RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub or operatorhub.io) rather than Helm or static manifests

original.statement: cert-manager no longer publishes OperatorHub packages; v1.16.5 is the last cert-manager release on OperatorHub (RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub and operatorhub.io), and the cert-manager-olm repository is archived.

corrected.statement: cert-manager no longer publishes OperatorHub packages; v1.16.5 is the last release on RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub and operatorhub.io. Exposed: environments that install cert-manager through an OLM Subscription to the OperatorHub package named cert-manager.

decision.reason: [ev-c3d5e62490c3] says cert-manager no longer publishes OperatorHub packages, so v1.16.5 is the last OperatorHub release, and the package path is operators/cert-manager on both OperatorHub catalogs. The proposed undecidable leaf is wrong. It uses "environment-visibility-gap", which is not an allowed reason. Also, whether cert-manager is installed through OperatorHub/OLM is a configuration fact, not runtime state: an OLM Subscription for the cert-manager package shows it. The exposure should read that Subscription.
